en: "The Malaise won't get us. I'll protect you...
... I'll protect you."
Throats slit.
The well doesn't seem to have been used recently.
Looks pretty deep.
"Prisoner 545"
No visible wounds.
Must have died of hunger.
Seems he wasn't able to make it up.
The tunnel collapsed.
The marks on the wall suggest it was dug with a small tool.
A little spoon.
There's something at the bottom.
It's dark down there.
Not that I'm scared.
But I'm getting tired of diving into blackness and groping about in the murk.
People really throw all sorts of junk into wells.
No wonder they got sick, drinking from the same place as they dumped their shit.
Fortunately, there are some idiots out there who also drop gold into wells.
So full of water, it looks like it's gonna burst any minute.
Blech.
All the heaviest stuff has piled up here.
Ah!
This tunnel was cleared out very roughly.
Doesn't look too solid.
A dusty old bag that someone left here a long time ago.
The hole in this wall is extremely small.
Except maybe for a child.
There's a whole list of names engraved on it.
Can't make it out, it’s too old.
"HZ"
There's a little plate on the ground.
"To my late husband"
There's another more recent inscription under it:
"To my daughter"
"To my son"
"To my cat"
The money from the collection.
Judging by the engravings, the body in this sarcophagus must have been someone important...
Hmm... the treasure hunter with the weird hairdo must have opened this sarcophagus...
... and never made it back up.
Looks the poor bugger found something, though.
Someone tried to get down with this rope...
... but it's much too short.
"Here lie the Architects."
"Mathieu I, Scribe"
There are bones in the alcove over the inscription.
At least two different people.
But both incomplete.
"Mathieu II, Scribe"
The bones in this alcove belong to two different people.
The guy burying them must have got them all mixed up.
"Thomas, Master Sculptor"
The alcove is full of little statuettes representing all kinds of creatures on the island.
There's also a brush drawn on the urn in the middle.
"Gwenaël, Master Architect"
A crossed brush and trowel are drawn on the urn.
With some very elaborate bas-reliefs all around.
"Pascal, Lead Foreman"
The alcove is cluttered up with piles of paper.
Payment orders bearing the royal seal.
"Christophe, Cryptographer"
An indecipherable message inscribed at the foot of the urn.
But the strangest thing of all is this little goat figurine right next to it.
"Sébastien, Scribe"
More or less elaborate little toys arranged around the urn in the alcove.
Most of them bearing the inscription "Ludum".
"Steve, Lead Merchant"
Unlike the other urns, this one is made of platinum.
The cover bears a coat of arms:
A closed fist with the middle finger up.
The piles of gold coins are a good indication of his contribution.
"Joan, Wandering Merchant"
The name "Joan" seems to cover an older name.
"Gui"... "Guil" something. It's been erased.
There are gold coins scattered all over the ground.
"Yoann, Master Bard"
The alcove is cluttered up with miniature instruments.
"Second Architect Noémie"
The wolf ornamenting this stele shows that it was a formidable combatant...
... with a weak spot for bananas.
"To our architects lost in the great Krunch"
"Ben, Master Copyist"
A slab covered with short messages, none longer than 140 characters...
... and a little blue bird engraved on the urn.
Probably a spy.
Nothing worth bothering about.
Someone's already plundered this rack.
The collection of weapons on this rack looks more interesting than the other one.
The prison guards sure won't need them any more.
"Live target training"
A supply of bows and arrows.
Hmm?
The prison's archers were really useless...
Only one arrow hit the target.
Right in the head.
A hole where they dumped the guys they never wanted to hear from again.
Someone got a rope down.
Wonder if it was for getting in or out...
Hard to say how many died here.
Anyway, there's room for more before it’s full.
Well, well!
Looks like someone pulled this body out of the pile.
Pockets turned inside out. Must have been looking for something.
But judging by the length of the rope, the pillager couldn't have made it out the top.
Hmmm...
Seems to have gotten lost along the way.
Someone sketched a sort of map on a sheet of paper.
It refers to the Cells, the Promenade of the Condemned and a network of hidden sewers!
Some smartass who was a bit more organized than the rest of them must have been planning to escape.
It's too bad this sketch is incomplete.
Where could he have gone to?
There's noise coming from behind this door.
What?! What is it?
